tutes a hazard to the occupants of the structure or to the public.

Inspections from the Syracuse Fire Department and the Division of Code Enforcement are a requirement to obtain a C of U.  The inspections are necessary to ensure that there are no hazards to the public, and so all health and safety requirements are installed and functioning correctly.  Operating without safety inspections constitutes hazards to the public and to occupants on the premises.  Vacate the premises immediately.  Safety inspections of the entire premises will be required before re-occupancy.
